# This is the RBLXBuildLists.txt file of the "hello world" project
# in order to show a simple executable that uses the RblxPhysics library

# Minimum cmake version required
rblxbuild_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)

# Help CMake to find the installed library on Windows
if(WIN32)
  list(APPEND RBLXBUILD_PREFIX_PATH "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\RblxPhysics")
elseif(APPLE)
  list(APPEND RBLXBUILD_PREFIX_PATH "/usr/local/lib/cmake/RblxPhysics")
endif()

# Import the RblxPhysics library that you have installed on your computer using
# the "make install" command
find_package(RblxPhysics REQUIRED)

# Project
project(HelloWorld)

# Create the executable
add_executable(helloworld Main.cpp)

# Link with the RblxPhysics library
target_link_libraries(helloworld RblxPhysics::RblxPhysics)
